notes.title: BackRoomsLost 0.2 version officially released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/f26b5bed079783b45cc4c40b041d4cd7dd9a44ca.png[/img]

[h1]In terms of gaming [/h1]
1. Camera shake and VHS visual effects return, players can adjust and select them in the "Settings" option. 
2. Add first person actions, including jumping, running, using props, and a series of first person actions 
3. Added localized languages, players can choose to switch between Chinese, English, Japanese, French, and Russian for the game. 
4. The microphone system has been redone, and players can modify the microphone volume and device options in "Settings - Games" 
5. Remake the icons of the multiplayer interaction system, allowing players to obtain specific task objectives through interactive icons 
6. Added monster jump kill CG in multiplayer mode 

[h1]Interface aspect [/h1]
1. Replace the original 3D menu interface with a 2D interface, allowing players to view updated content and community through the main interface 
2. Add CG animation at the beginning and game loading interface. 
3. The "Create Room" option in the multiplayer online list has been moved to the "Create Room" section, where players can view files, threat levels, monster types at various levels, and create the desired room as needed (single players can also open single player rooms for multiplayer map play). 

[h1]In terms of maps [/h1]
1. Optimized LEVEL-0 clue prompts, players will have clearer task objectives 
2. Added game tutorial levels, players can enter and familiarize themselves with game operations through the "Tutorial" on the main interface 
3. Added escape mode and two escape maps - LEVEL! Along with LEVEL 35, two new monsters and scene mechanisms have been added for players to experience. 

The specific update content can be viewed https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2924300/view/4551542855324140088?l=schinese 

We warmly welcome players to provide feedback and suggestions within our STEAM community, which will serve as a reference for us to continuously improve gameplay and fix issues. You can also check the progress of game development and related activities in our official accounts of YOUTUBE, Station B, Weibo or Tiktok. 

Thank you all for your support and understanding in the Fresh Experience version 


Cheers!! 
Back Room: Lost Production Team

notes.title: Version 0.2 Update Preview! New game modes and optimisations are on their way!
notes.content:
Hello, backroom explorers.
  
  It's that time of the month again, when the monthly update trailer is released. We've been working on the game for three months now, and it's getting closer and closer to what you've all imagined, so we're sure we'll be wrapping up the sneak preview phase soon and bringing you the official version of the game.
  Of course, this update is just as exciting, and we're sure you can't wait to get into the game;

   ① Character movement and visual shaking redone. Character movement feedback is smoother and more comfortable, and action execution feedback is smoother. Character visual shaking reworked, the visual shaking effect is more in favour of realistic simulation, the player can be adjusted in the ‘Settings - Game’ in the ‘degree of shaking’
 
   ② VHS effect has been added to increase game immersion, players can turn off the ‘VHS effect’ in ‘Settings - Game’.
 
   ③ Microphone system has been redone, players can modify the microphone volume and device options in ‘Settings - Game’.

   ③ The microphone system has been redone, players can change the microphone volume and device options in ‘Settings - Game’. The player will be prompted with localised text when they are near a clue, making it easier for them to get to the clue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/4fb09c6d9a3c8920860fab39f4007aaf50ad4135.gif[/img]

[b][h2] Main interface overhaul[/h2][/b]

[h3] ①. We listened to players' suggestions and cancelled the original 3D trigger-based interface and switched to a 2D type interface to reduce the time players spend switching between options;[/h3] [h3] ②.

[h3] ②. New ‘Teaching’ and ‘Community’ options have been added, allowing players to enter training levels or participate in STEAM community discussions as needed.
[h3] ③.
 ③. Room creation in the online multiplayer list has been moved to the ‘Create Room’ option, where players can view the profiles, threat level, and monster types for each level and create a room as needed (singles can also open a 1-player room for multiplayer maps)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/d9c21b99214a01e630675f3a8c82e929f339dabd.png[/img]
 
[b][h2]Gameplay wise[/h2][/b]

[h3]We've introduced Escape Mode in this update - players need to dodge the obstacles in the map, beware of the ubiquitous traps, and escape in a tense and exciting environment with monsters chasing them.
Please note that it is not always a good idea to be the first to run, but only by making good use of the items at hand and having quick reflexes will you be able to successfully leave these dangerous levels.
In the game mode, players can compete for the title of ‘Speed Pioneer’, which will be displayed as the game's MVP in the ending animation. [h3]

[strike][h3]‘FL-35’ Sewers[/h3][/strike]

 The dark and damp underground space, the limited space filled with stench and sewage, was not a tier that could be inhabited by vagabonds by any stretch of the imagination. Not to mention the fact that it is filled with countless rat entities and limb clusters that move around stupidly in the shadows!
Don't take this lightly, take the axe in your hand! Split through all the obstacles you come across on your way, and don't give up any hope until the evacuation is successful!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/fbc1a7e10e419b98d33ffbcc1dc5926f2223ea94.gif[/img]

[u][h3]"FL_!’ [/h3][/u]
  Threshold space filled with blaring alarms all around, ubiquitous medical facility barriers in the way and ward doors opening at any moment.
Caution! Dodge these obstacles in time or you'll be dinner for the Laughing Nightmare! Make good use of the equipment at hand and board the train at the last second to escape this hellhole!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/e3c9bf1806ecd51ece1482cd40cb21b1b360b72d.gif[/img]

[h2]Monster aspect[/h2]

[b][h3]‘Limb Cluster’[/h3][/b]
A multi-limbed entity composed of human limbs, each arm reaching out in all directions in order to hunt prey. In its inactive state, the paper ball usually hides in dark, damp environments with a low whimpering sound, and the entity moves slowly at this time;
When it finds prey to feed on, it will drive the prey into a narrow passage space at great speed to cut off the prey's escape route, and then force the prey to a dead end before slowly sending it into its mouth to be chewed up by the limb mass below.
When you realise that you've been preyed upon, don't hesitate to look for a way to escape from the obstacle, it's too big to get into tighter spaces!


[b][h3]‘Laughing Nightmare’[/h3][/b]
  The most frequent type of monster in the Back Room genre. No one knows exactly what his physical appearance is, only that it usually approaches its prey with an extremely creepy smile and tears it apart in a flash. He is usually found in the darkness, and has a stronger desire to hunt down single prey.
He is usually found in the dark, and has a stronger desire to hunt lone prey. If you're unlucky enough to meet him, just run towards the back of the room where it's brightly lit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/56350b8ce5a684f1c4b147e9a22d65441fe154a3.gif[/img]

[h2]
 In terms of gameplay scenarios[/h2]
The Escape Mode map has a large number of new obstacles and props, which players can experience in the ‘Teaching’ section.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/b4430a31c7e79acf75358c856c7b8610113efff4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/4b783d37cdf40c042f748ef99778410d28b1acb2.png[/img]

[h3]
[u]‘Garbage bag’ “cardboard box pile”[/h3][/u]

An entity that appears widely in FL_35, usually its emits a foul odour, and sometimes these entities block escape routes causing the player to be trapped in them. Of course, it's a good thing if you have an axe in your hand, as they are very easy to smash with an axe!

[u][h3]‘Planks’[/h3].
[/u]
A much more widely occurring entity, most of which block the doors so that escapees can't get out easily, but of course an axe can take care of them easily.

[u][h3]‘Rotten Mud’[/h3][/u]

 Can you imagine the despair you feel when you're fleeing from a mass of limbs and you step on a puddle of foul-smelling, disgusting mud that slows down your escape? Don't hesitate to run as far away from them as you can!


 After this update, we'll be redoing the map and the gameplay of the single-player mode, and we're sure that a new Lost in the Backroom will be coming out in the near future!
[i]
 We welcome feedback and suggestions from players in our STEAM community to help us continue to improve gameplay and fix issues. You can also check out the game development progress and related activities on our official YOUTUBE, B-station, Weibo or Jitterbug accounts.
Thank you for your support and understanding during the Sneak Peek version[/i].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               BackRooms_ Lost Production Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/6e7f295c8869838280e69b0b07352bedea84f6f4.png[/img]

notes.title: After a month, Backrooms_Lost is about to receive its first major update!
notes.content:
After a month, Backroom Lost is about to receive its first major update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/19262956899b6fd1409d9a4441a52945257228aa.png[/img]

We would like to celebrate the first major update to Backroom Lost in his career and thank all players for their understanding and support. Players can update automatically via STEAM or by logging back into STEAM.
There are a lot of content in this update, so please check it out carefully:

■Game main menu interface updated, new multiplayer online lobby

■The multiplayer mode system has been redone, with new features such as regional voice chat and text chat, and players can press the ‘v’ key to start chatting.

■Players can customise room creation, support up to four players, and choose any map to play on.

■Character model refinement, character movement optimisation, player name can be displayed in the game.

■FL0 map reset, environment refinement, lift lever control.

■FL_POOL_0.1 and FL_POOL maps have been added to the game.

■New pass in FL_0

■New anchor mode and smooth camera mode in ESC menu settings.


■ Currently the multiplayer online lobby uses STEAM nodes, STEAM network fluctuations may cause some players to be unable to search for other players' rooms. If you encounter such problems, please use an accelerator or check whether the STEAM network connection is normal.

New reveal level added

Reduced number of capacitors players need to find to unlock electric gates


[h1]Character Aspects[/h1]
New character design, with modifications to the original character model and movement aspects to make it easier for other players to find their companions

Chat bar and owner management tool are added in the room, it's time to try to explore the back room with adventurers from all over the world!

We've added animations to some of the multiplayer levels to give players short, helpful hints. Maybe a good animation will help get players excited about playing, right?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991945/16adc4a5feb19da6cc3022d31c62128b2904c2a6.png[/img]

Player headers will display the corresponding player's STEAM name, making it easier to distinguish players.

[h2]Anchor mode! [/h2]
In some cases, in order to minimize the gore of the scene, we've created a separate standalone anchor mode to make it easier for you to record live!



Stay tuned for version 0.1!

notes.title: VERSION 0.0.3 HOTFIX
notes.content:
According to players' feedback on the game, we have improved and fixed the following game content and problems
1. According to players' feedback, the elevator in LEVEL0 in multiplayer mode has been changed from inductive elevator to lever elevator to prevent players from being unable to pass the level due to elevator problem.
2. Changed the player death sound effect from 2D to 3D in multiplayer mode, so that when the player dies, other players will not hear the scream from a distance.
3. Fixed the stairs on both sides of LEVEL188 in multiplayer mode.
4. New loading interface when switching levels in multiplayer mode.

notes.title: Version 0.0.2 update and issue fixes and optimizations
notes.content:
Based on the feedback and suggestions made by players on July 26th BST, we have updated the game and fixed the issues

On July 26th, BST, we received feedback from players about the game and urgently fixed the problems that affected the gameplay.

[h1][b]Updates and Fixes[/b][/h1]
1. Modified the problem that the sensitivity cannot be adjusted in the settings.
2. Modified the problem of high sensitivity in the settings, now players can play normally with 400dpi mouse sensitivity.
3. Fixed anomaly of player's jumping strength in single-player mode.
4. Added more guidance subtitles and TIPS to the map in multiplayer mode.
5. Fixed the problem that the entity locking players in LEVEL0 map in multiplayer mode caused newborn players to be unable to play the game.
6. Added more quest props and almond water to LEVEL0 map in multiplayer mode.
7. Fixed the issue that some doors in LEVEL188 cannot be opened in multiplayer mode.
8. Fixed the problem that the lighting of LEVEL188 day and night is not obvious and the music cannot be heard by the client players in multiplayer mode.
9. Reduced the opening time of the elevator in the LEVEL0 of multiplayer mode.
10. Modified the appearance of the player's character model in multiplayer mode.
11. Added liquid pain to LEVEL 188 in multiplayer mode.
12. Fixed the problem that the ship in LEVEL37 in single-player mode caused the player to get stuck in the ship when going downhill.
13.Fixed level188 access door interaction area error in single player mode
14.Fixed an issue where players could not switch viewpoints after dying in multiplayer mode
15.Fixed misaligned wooden door trigger box next to LEVEL188 stairway in single-player mode

[h1][b]Screen optimization[/b][/h1]
1. Improved the overall clarity and brightness of LEVEL0 in multiplayer mode.
2. Improved the filter and clarity of LEVEL188 in multiplayer mode.
3. Improve the filter and brightness of REDZONE base in single-player mode.
4.SSO Outpost Hub in single player mode has improved filters and graphics.
